description: Indicative, dated fare ranges for hiring a vehicle with driver for a group trip in India between two places, for the vehicles that fit the group, with cost per person. Figures come from Yippigo's published fare method; verified operators quote the exact price.

days.description: Trip length in days, 1–15. Default: the usual length for the trip, as the route page shows it

from.description: Pickup city or town, by name or slug (e.g. Ahmedabad)

to.description: Destination, by name or slug (e.g. Statue of Unity)

vehicle.description: Optional. A vehicle class code (sedan, suv, tt12, tt17, tt26, urbania, minibus32, coach45, coach55) or a kind (car, tempo_traveller, minibus, coach, bus).

name: estimate_group_trip_fare

per_person.description: Per person for the group size given (total ÷ group size, all vehicles together); with no group size, per person with all seats filled

per_person_full.description: Per person if every seat is filled

range.description: Indicative total per vehicle; null when public fares are switched off

total_range.description: For all vehicles together, when more than one is needed

title: Estimate a group trip fare
